notes: 진저브레드맨 영어 녹음 대본(mk_script.py). 목소리·모델은 voice_script_el.json 그대로. 영어 글에는 한국어 연기 지시를 붙이지 않는다(2026-11 재녹음 사고). 녹음 뒤 mlx_whisper 로 받아써 반복과 한국어 혼입을 검사.

lines.text: 눈이 펄펄 내리는 크리스마스 전날이에요. 숲가 작은 집에 할머니와 할아버지가 살았어요.
lines.en: It is the day before Christmas, and snow is falling softly. In a little house at the edge of the woods lived a little old woman and a little old man.
segs: It is the day before Christmas, and snow is falling softly. In a little house at the edge of the woods lived a little old woman and a little old man.

lines.text: 두 사람은 사이좋게 지냈지만, 집에 아이가 없어 늘 조금 쓸쓸했어요.
lines.en: They were happy together, but they had no little child, and that made them a little lonely.
segs: They were happy together, but they had no little child, and that made them a little lonely.

lines.text: 오늘은 진저브레드 아이를 하나 만들어 볼까?
lines.en: Shall I make a little gingerbread boy today?
segs: Shall I make a little gingerbread boy today?

lines.text: 좋지! 달콤한 생강 냄새가 집 안에 가득하겠구나.
lines.en: Oh yes! The whole house will smell of sweet ginger.
segs: Oh yes! The whole house will smell of sweet ginger.

lines.text: 할머니는 반죽을 밀고, 아이 모양 틀로 꾹 찍었어요.
lines.en: The little old woman rolled out the dough and pressed down the boy-shaped cutter.
segs: The little old woman rolled out the dough and pressed down the boy-shaped cutter.

lines.text: 눈은 건포도, 단추는 사탕, 신발은 설탕으로 해야지.
lines.en: Raisins for the eyes, candies for the buttons, and sugar for the shoes.
segs: Raisins for the eyes, candies for the buttons, and sugar for the shoes.

lines.text: 입은 할머니가 먼저. 설탕으로 활짝 웃는 입!
lines.en: I'll do the mouth first. A big sugar smile!
segs: I'll do the mouth first. A big sugar smile!

lines.text: 건포도 눈은 어디에 붙일까요? 위, 가운데, 아래 중에서 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: Where do the raisin eyes go? Tap the top, the middle, or the bottom.
segs: Where do the raisin eyes go? Tap the top, the middle, or the bottom.

lines.text: 그렇지, 눈은 위에!
lines.en: That's right, eyes on top!

lines.text: 사탕 단추는 어디에 붙일까요?
lines.en: Where do the candy buttons go?
segs: Where do the candy buttons go?

lines.text: 맞아, 단추는 가운데!
lines.en: Yes, buttons in the middle!

lines.text: 설탕 신발은 어디에 붙일까요?
lines.en: Where do the sugar shoes go?
segs: Where do the sugar shoes go?

lines.text: 그래, 신발은 아래에!
lines.en: Good, shoes at the bottom!

lines.text: 거기는 아니야. 눈은 얼굴, 위쪽이지.
lines.en: Not there. Eyes go on the face, up at the top.
segs: Not there. Eyes go on the face, up at the top.

lines.text: 단추는 배, 가운데란다.
lines.en: Buttons go on the tummy, in the middle.
segs: Buttons go on the tummy, in the middle.

lines.text: 신발은 발, 맨 아래지.
lines.en: Shoes go on the feet, right at the bottom.
segs: Shoes go on the feet, right at the bottom.

lines.text: 할머니는 건포도 눈을 위에, 사탕 단추를 가운데, 설탕 신발을 아래에 붙였어요.
lines.en: She put the raisin eyes on top, the candy buttons in the middle, and the sugar shoes at the bottom.
segs: She put the raisin eyes on top, the candy buttons in the middle, and the sugar shoes at the bottom.

lines.text: 허허, 꼭 살아 있는 아이 같구나.
lines.en: Ho ho, he looks just like a real little boy.
segs: Ho ho, he looks just like a real little boy.

lines.text: 할머니는 쟁반을 오븐에 넣었어요. 생강 냄새가 솔솔 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: She slid the tray into the oven. Soon the smell of ginger filled the kitchen.
segs: She slid the tray into the oven. Soon the smell of ginger filled the kitchen.

lines.text: 킁킁, 다 됐나 보네!
lines.en: Sniff, sniff. I think he's done!
segs: Sniff, sniff. I think he's done!

lines.text: 오븐 문을 톡 눌러 열어 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the oven door to open it.
segs: Tap the oven door to open it.

lines.text: 할머니가 오븐 문을 열었어요.
lines.en: The little old woman opened the oven door.
segs: The little old woman opened the oven door.

lines.text: 덜컥! 문이 열리자마자, 진저브레드맨이 폴짝 뛰어나왔어요!
lines.en: Clunk! The moment the door opened, out jumped the Gingerbread Man!
segs: Clunk! The moment the door opened, out jumped the Gingerbread Man!

lines.text: 안녕! 나는 진저브레드맨!
lines.en: Hello! I'm the Gingerbread Man!

lines.text: 어머나!
lines.en: Oh my!

lines.text: 아이고! 저기 간다!
lines.en: Goodness! There he goes!

lines.text: 진저브레드맨은 문밖으로 쌩 달려 나갔어요.
lines.en: The Gingerbread Man dashed right out the door.
segs: The Gingerbread Man dashed right out the door.

lines.text: 얘야, 거기 서!
lines.en: Little boy, stop right there!

lines.text: 돌아오너라!
lines.en: Come back here!

lines.text: 진저브레드맨을 톡 눌러요. 같이 외쳐 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the Gingerbread Man. Shout it with him!
segs: Tap the Gingerbread Man. Shout it with him!

lines.text: 달려라 달려, 날 잡아 봐! 나는 진저브레드맨!
lines.en: Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man!
segs: Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man!

lines.text: 할머니와 할아버지가 헐떡헐떡 뒤를 쫓았어요. 하지만 진저브레드맨이 훨씬 빨랐어요.
lines.en: The little old woman and the little old man ran after him, huffing and puffing. But the Gingerbread Man was much faster.
segs: The little old woman and the little old man ran after him, huffing and puffing. But the Gingerbread Man was much faster.

lines.text: 진저브레드맨은 헛간 앞을 지났어요. 사람들이 도리깨로 탁탁 곡식을 털고 있었어요.
lines.en: He ran past a barn, where threshers were beating the grain, thump, thump.
segs: He ran past a barn, where threshers were beating the grain, thump, thump.

lines.text: 할머니한테서도, 할아버지한테서도 도망쳤는데, 너희한테서도 도망칠 수 있지!
lines.en: I've run away from a little old woman, and a little old man, and I can run away from you, I can!
segs: I've run away from a little old woman, and a little old man, and I can run away from you, I can!

lines.text: 탈곡하는 사람들도 도리깨를 던지고 뒤를 쫓았어요. 하지만 따라잡을 수 없었어요.
lines.en: The threshers dropped their flails and ran after him. But they could not catch him.
segs: The threshers dropped their flails and ran after him. But they could not catch him.

lines.text: 눈 덮인 들판에서는 사람들이 마른 풀을 베고 있었어요.
lines.en: In a snowy field, mowers were cutting the dry grass.
segs: In a snowy field, mowers were cutting the dry grass.

lines.text: 할머니, 할아버지, 탈곡하는 사람들한테서도 도망쳤는데, 너희한테서도 도망칠 수 있지!
lines.en: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, and a barn full of threshers, and I can run away from you, I can!
segs: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, and a barn full of threshers, and I can run away from you, I can!

lines.text: 풀 베는 사람들도 낫을 내려놓고 뒤를 쫓았어요. 줄이 점점 길어졌어요.
lines.en: The mowers put down their scythes and ran after him too. The line grew longer and longer.
segs: The mowers put down their scythes and ran after him too. The line grew longer and longer.

lines.text: 길가 울타리 안에서 소가 건초를 우물우물 먹고 있었어요.
lines.en: By the road, a cow was munching hay behind a fence.
segs: By the road, a cow was munching hay behind a fence.

lines.text: 음매! 진저브레드맨, 거기 서!
lines.en: Moo! Gingerbread Man, stop right there!
segs: Moo! Gingerbread Man, stop right there!

lines.text: 할머니, 할아버지, 탈곡하는 사람들, 풀 베는 사람들한테서도 도망쳤는데, 너한테서도 도망칠 수 있지!
lines.en: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, and a field full of mowers, and I can run away from you, I can!
segs: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, and a field full of mowers, and I can run away from you, I can!

lines.text: 소는 느릿느릿 쫓아왔어요. 진저브레드맨은 쌩쌩 달렸어요.
lines.en: The cow plodded along slowly. The Gingerbread Man zipped ahead.
segs: The cow plodded along slowly. The Gingerbread Man zipped ahead.

lines.text: 누가 더 빨라요? 더 빠른 쪽을 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: Who is faster? Tap the faster one.
segs: Who is faster? Tap the faster one.

lines.text: 그래요, 진저브레드맨이 훨씬 빨라요. 소는 느릿느릿.
lines.en: Yes, the Gingerbread Man is much faster. The cow is slow, slow, slow.
segs: Yes, the Gingerbread Man is much faster. The cow is slow, slow, slow.

lines.text: 소는 느릿느릿 걸어요. 쌩쌩 달리는 쪽은 누구일까요?
lines.en: The cow walks slowly. Who is the one zipping along?
segs: The cow walks slowly. Who is the one zipping along?

lines.text: 돼지 우리 옆을 지날 때, 돼지가 꿀꿀 고개를 내밀었어요.
lines.en: As he passed the pigpen, a pig poked its head over the fence. Oink!
segs: As he passed the pigpen, a pig poked its head over the fence. Oink!

lines.text: 꿀꿀! 진저브레드맨, 나도 잡을 거야!
lines.en: Oink, oink! Gingerbread Man, I'll catch you too!
segs: Oink, oink! Gingerbread Man, I'll catch you too!

lines.text: 할머니, 할아버지, 탈곡하는 사람들, 풀 베는 사람들, 소한테서도 도망쳤는데, 너한테서도 도망칠 수 있지!
lines.en: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, a field full of mowers, and a cow, and I can run away from you, I can!
segs: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, a field full of mowers, and a cow, and I can run away from you, I can!

lines.text: 돼지도 뒤따라 달렸어요. 이제 줄이 아주 길어졌어요.
lines.en: The pig ran after him too. Now the line was very, very long.
segs: The pig ran after him too. Now the line was very, very long.

lines.text: 줄 맨 뒤에서 달리는 건 누구일까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: Who is running at the very back of the line? Tap them.
segs: Who is running at the very back of the line? Tap them.

lines.text: 맞아요, 맨 뒤는 할머니예요. 맨 앞은 물론 진저브레드맨!
lines.en: That's right, the little old woman is at the back. And at the front, of course, the Gingerbread Man!
segs: That's right, the little old woman is at the back. And at the front, of course, the Gingerbread Man!

lines.text: 그건 줄 가운데에 있어요. 맨 뒤, 끝에 있는 건 누구일까요?
lines.en: That one is in the middle. Who is at the very back, at the end?
segs: That one is in the middle. Who is at the very back, at the end?

lines.text: 맨 앞은 진저브레드맨, 맨 뒤는 할머니였어요.
lines.en: The Gingerbread Man was at the front, and the little old woman was at the very back.
segs: The Gingerbread Man was at the front, and the little old woman was at the very back.

lines.text: 진저브레드맨은 숲가까지 달려왔어요. 나무 아래 여우가 느긋하게 누워 있었어요.
lines.en: The Gingerbread Man ran all the way to the edge of the woods. Under a tree, a fox was lying lazily.
segs: The Gingerbread Man ran all the way to the edge of the woods. Under a tree, a fox was lying lazily.

lines.text: 어, 여우다!
lines.en: Oh, a fox!

lines.text: 할머니, 할아버지, 탈곡하는 사람들, 풀 베는 사람들, 소, 돼지한테서도 도망쳤는데, 너한테서도 도망칠 수 있지!
lines.en: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, a field full of mowers, a cow, and a pig, and I can run away from you, I can!
segs: I've run away from a little old woman, a little old man, a barn full of threshers, a field full of mowers, a cow, and a pig, and I can run away from you, I can!

lines.text: 흐음, 세상에서 네가 가장 빠르다고?
lines.en: Hmm. So you're the fastest in the whole world?
segs: Hmm. So you're the fastest in the whole world?

lines.text: 그럼!
lines.en: Of course!

lines.text: 그래? 한번 보자.
lines.en: Is that so? Let's see.

lines.text: 여우는 천천히 일어나 기지개를 쭉 폈어요.
lines.en: The fox got up slowly and stretched, long and lazy.
segs: The fox got up slowly and stretched, long and lazy.

lines.text: 여우가 달리기 시작했어요. 여우는 소보다, 돼지보다, 누구보다 빨랐어요!
lines.en: Then the fox began to run. He was faster than the cow, faster than the pig, faster than anyone!
segs: Then the fox began to run. He was faster than the cow, faster than the pig, faster than anyone!

lines.text: 어어?
lines.en: Uh oh?

lines.text: 휙! 여우가 진저브레드맨 바로 앞을 가로막았어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The fox leaped right in front of the Gingerbread Man.
segs: Whoosh! The fox leaped right in front of the Gingerbread Man.

lines.text: 잡았다!
lines.en: Got you!

lines.text: 어? 조금 없어졌네.
lines.en: Oh dear! I'm quarter gone!

lines.text: 반이 없어졌네.
lines.en: I'm half gone!

lines.text: 다 없어졌어!
lines.en: I'm all gone!

lines.text: 그 뒤로 진저브레드맨은 아무 말도 하지 않았어요.
lines.en: And after that, the Gingerbread Man never said another word.
segs: And after that, the Gingerbread Man never said another word.

lines.text: 음, 달콤한 생강 맛이구나.
lines.en: Mmm. Sweet and gingery.

lines.text: 여우는 배를 두드리며 숲으로 느릿느릿 사라졌어요.
lines.en: The fox patted his tummy and strolled away into the woods.
segs: The fox patted his tummy and strolled away into the woods.

lines.text: 뒤쫓아 온 사람들과 소, 돼지가 숲가에 멈춰 서서 헐떡였어요.
lines.en: The people, the cow, and the pig all stopped at the edge of the woods, huffing and puffing.
segs: The people, the cow, and the pig all stopped at the edge of the woods, huffing and puffing.

lines.text: 하아, 하아. 참 빨랐구나.
lines.en: Huff, puff. He sure was fast.
segs: Huff, puff. He sure was fast.

lines.text: 그래도 참 예쁘게 웃는 아이였지.
lines.en: He had such a lovely smile, didn't he?
segs: He had such a lovely smile, didn't he?

lines.text: 눈이 소리 없이 내렸어요. 모두 천천히 집으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Snow fell quietly. Slowly, everyone went back home.
segs: Snow fell quietly. Slowly, everyone went back home.

lines.text: 작은 집 창문에 따뜻한 불이 켜졌어요.
lines.en: In the little house, a warm light came on in the window.
segs: In the little house, a warm light came on in the window.

ch_S5_2: Look! A gingerbread man! Stop him, catch him!
Look! A gingerbread man! Stop him, catch him!
ch_S6_2: Look there! A gingerbread man! Stop!
Look there! A gingerbread man! Stop!
